clips.name: v3_S1_s1716
lines: [bright, cheeky] 牛顿爵士，苹果砸头疼吗？
[offended, sharp] It did not hit my head.
[cold, final] Three minutes.
[thrilled] 才三分钟？看我的。
[innocent, confidently wrong] 哦，那是砸到您脚了？
[irritated, correcting] No. It fell to the ground. Straight down.
[absorbed, thinking aloud] Why always straight down?
[catching himself, cold] We are done.
[unbothered, pleased with herself] 赶我？看到没，说错一句，他就忍不住。
[casual, provoking] 听说引力那本书，其实是哈雷写的？
[outraged] Halley paid for it. I wrote it.
[innocent] 皇家学会怎么不出钱？
[disgusted] Their money went on a book about fish.
[petty, triumphant] Your time is up.
[cheeky] 沙子还在掉呢。直直往下。
clips.heard: 牛頓爵士,蘋果砸頭疼嗎?才三分鐘,看我的!哦,那是砸到您腳了?趕我?看到沒?說錯一句,他就忍不住。聽說引力那本書,其實是哈雷寫的。哈雷寫了,我寫了。皇家學會怎麼不出錢?沙子還在吊呢,直直往下。

clips.name: v3_S2_s1716
lines: [casual, dropping a bomb] 胡克说过，引力定律有他一份功劳。
[furious] Hooke!
[ranting] He wanted my credit. I nearly cut Book Three.
[needling] 您就这么不想发表？
[prickly] Who would understand it?
[dry, sour] At Cambridge, I often lectured to walls.
[deadpan] 墙，辛苦了。
[sly] 胡克去世第二年，您就出了《光学》？
[flat, too quick, dodging] My friends insisted. Next question.
clips.heard: 胡克说过,引力定律有他一份功劳您就这么不想发表强,辛苦了胡克去世第二年,您就出了光学

clips.name: v3_S3_s1716
lines: [sweet, going for it] 好。微积分是莱布尼茨发明的吧？
[exploding] Leibniz? It was mine!
[curious] 那皇家学会怎么判的？
[proud, composed] A committee looked into it. Very fair.
[innocent] 会长，委员谁选的？
[proud] I did.
[quicker] 报告谁写的？
[prouder] I did.
[quicker still] 夸报告的文章，谁写的？
[natural] Anonymous.
[deadpan] 也是他。
[cold fury] Out. Now.
clips.heard: 好,維基芬是來個泥詞發明的吧viblet? It was mine!那黃家學會怎麼判的?a committee looked into it, very fair會長,委員誰選的?I did報告誰寫的?I did跨報告的文章誰寫的?anonymous也是他out, now

clips.name: v3_S4_s1716
lines: [puzzled] 这写的什么？像密码。
[sharp] Give me that.
[sincere, careful] 您为什么威胁要烧死他们？
[matter-of-fact] At birth, I could fit in that. My father was already dead.
[matter-of-fact, tight] At three, my mother married again. She left me with my grandmother.
[sincere] 那您……原谅她了吗？
[steady, holding it in] When she was dying, I sat up whole nights with her.
[steady, voice catching] I dressed her blisters with my own hands.
[moved, trying to sound professional] ……时间到了。谢谢您，牛顿爵士。
[gruff] Sit down. Next question.
[delighted, teary, teasing] 那……苹果到底砸没砸到您的头？
[exasperated, fighting a smile] For the last time. It did not hit my head.
clips.heard: 这写的什么? 像密码?您为什么威胁要烧死她们?那您原谅她了吗?时间到了谢谢您,牛顿爵士那苹果到底杂没杂到您的头?
